name: Quality Online Education Group Inc.
summary: Quality Online Education Group, Inc. operates as an e-learning company which provides comprehensive online English lessons to K12 students. Its focuses on developing confidence in students to be proficient in English language and achieve their academic goals. Its products include artificial intelligence tutoring, 1:4, tutoring, and education management software. The company was founded in August 2018 and is headquartered in Thornhill, Canada.
